notes: Researched landmark heights/styles for Harare CBD. See docs/references/LANDMARKS.md for sources. Colours are hex guesses. Entries with part_of are extra footprints of a landmark (podiums, wings, cores); style_confidence rates facade/colour notes separately from height/match confidence.

landmarks.name: Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe
landmarks.streets: 80 Samora Machel Ave (north side), between First St and Sam Nujoma St

style.notes: Tallest in Zimbabwe (1997, Clinton & Evans). Design modelled on the Great Zimbabwe conical tower / a grain silo: broad base tapering toward the top. ~37x37 m chamfered-square plan (OSM 9-sided). 5 podium levels + 23 office floors. Polished granite walls (etched rural-Zimbabwe scenes at podium) with narrow vertical dark-glass strips between granite piers. Taper/step the top ~6 floors in 2-3 setbacks to a narrow crown + short mast. Granite podium/banking hall = rbz_podium. Colours approximate.
5-level granite podium attached to the RBZ tower (adjoining footprint; assumed).

landmarks.name: Joina City
landmarks.streets: Cnr Jason Moyo Ave & Julius Nyerere Way

style.notes: Office tower (opened 2010, 'second/third tallest in Zimbabwe') on the Jason Moyo Ave / Julius Nyerere Way corner. Concrete shaft that becomes glass-sheathed toward the top and ends in a circular ring crown ('concrete form rises to a crescendo atop a circular ring'). 3 basement parking levels, 4 retail floors, 16 office floors. Podium = joina_city_podium. Glass colour is a guess.
Shopping-mall podium ~69x104 m: ground + 4 retail floors, big glazed atrium roof lights, 'JOINA CITY' signage on the corners.

landmarks.name: Karigamombe Centre
landmarks.streets: 53 Samora Machel Ave, cnr Julius Nyerere Way

style.notes: 1985 Clinton & Evans office tower of glass and concrete; Overture num_floors=8 is WRONG (20 floors, 92 m). Slender point tower (~26x22 m footprint) on the SE corner of Samora Machel Ave & Julius Nyerere Way; NBS (National Building Society) head office. The Mbuya Nehanda statue and pedestrian footbridges sit at this intersection. Facade details not verified.

landmarks.name: Livingstone House
landmarks.streets: 30 Samora Machel Ave (north side), between Leopold Takawira St and Julius Nyerere Way

style.notes: 1960 modernist office slab; tallest building in the Federation when completed. Continuous horizontal spandrel bands with ribbon windows, flat roof with lift overrun. Low podium = livingstone_house_podium. Colours approximate.
Adjoining lower block/podium of Livingstone House (assumed from adjacency).

landmarks.name: Mukwati Building
landmarks.streets: Cnr Fourth St (S.V. Muzenda St) & Livingstone Ave (Overture: Oliver Tambo Ave)

style.notes: Government office slab 84x23.5 m, long axis parallel to the avenues. Near-identical twin of Kaguvi Building one block south (same footprint and orientation) - build both from one kit. Probably the building listed as 'Earl Grey Building' (76 m/21 fl) in tallest-building lists (its colonial name). Facade = repetitive horizontal bands; approximate.

landmarks.name: Kaguvi Building
landmarks.streets: Cnr Fourth St (S.V. Muzenda St) & Central Ave (Overture: Ahmed Ben Bella Ave)

style.notes: Government offices (several ministries). Twin slab of Mukwati Building (84x23.5 m). Model identically.

landmarks.name: Old Mutual Centre
landmarks.streets: Cnr Jason Moyo Ave & Third St (Overture: Patrice Lumumba St)

style.notes: 18-storey office tower ~40x28 m, one block east of Africa Unity Square (~160 m). OSM height 66 m; lists say 72 m. Bronze-tinted glazing and 'OLD MUTUAL' crown signage are guesses.

landmarks.name: ZB Life Towers
landmarks.streets: 77 Jason Moyo Ave, near Sam Nujoma St / Speke Ave (Overture: Agostinho Neto Ave)

style.notes: 19-storey office + retail complex, 2 basement parking levels, ground-floor shopping arcade and lobby. Complex 74x30 m footprint (47 vertices) - model as lower wing + tower with stepped profile. OSM height 61.5 m. Listed among Harare's 'most beautiful' buildings; facade details unverified.

landmarks.name: Defence House
landmarks.streets: Kwame Nkrumah Ave, between Sam Nujoma St and Third St

style.notes: Ministry of Defence HQ. OSM: thin 54x10.7 m slab at 71 m plus a 13.6x11.4 m service core (defence_house_core) at 77.5 m rising above the roof. Floors estimated.
Lift/stair core rising above Defence House roof (OSM height).

landmarks.name: Century Towers
landmarks.streets: 45 Samora Machel Ave (south side), between Leopold Takawira St and Julius Nyerere Way

style.notes: Office tower; tenants listed on floors 4-17, so >=17 floors (18 assumed). Footprint ~33x25 m; adjoining f031ec8c likely its lower block.

landmarks.name: Pearl House (Pearl Assurance House)
landmarks.streets: 61 Samora Machel Ave, cnr First St

style.notes: 1959 office slab, 17 floors ('First Mutual Building'). Matched via a tenant address point at 'Pearl House cnr Samora Machel & First St' that falls on this 35x13.5 m footprint (Overture labels it 'First Capital Bank', a ground-floor tenant). Alternative candidate across First St: 4b76a206 (60x23 m).

landmarks.name: Monomotapa Hotel
landmarks.streets: 54 Park Lane (Overture: Jomo Kenyatta Lane) / Julius Nyerere Way

style.notes: 1974 hotel (Roy Densem & Partners), crescent/semicircular 'open book' slab overlooking Harare Gardens; concave face toward the gardens (NW). Continuous horizontal balcony bands; rooftop hotel sign. OSM footprint is only a thin curved sliver (~82 m arc) - extrude a ~16-20 m deep curved slab along it. Forms an 'S' (Salisbury) with the curved Charter House from the air.

landmarks.name: Social Security Centre (NSSA)
landmarks.streets: Cnr Sam Nujoma St & Julius Nyerere Way (Selous Ave / Park Lane end)

style.notes: NSSA HQ opposite the National Gallery at the head of Julius Nyerere Way; tenants up to 14th floor (>=15 floors, 16 assumed). Irregular 55x55 m footprint; adjoining 832051c2 (94x45 m) is the lower complex/annex.

landmarks.name: Chiyedza House
landmarks.streets: Cnr First St & Kwame Nkrumah Ave

style.notes: 12-floor office slab 44.5x24 m; OSM height 38.5 m.

landmarks.name: Angwa City
landmarks.streets: Cnr Angwa St (Overture: Sir Seretse Khama St) & Kwame Nkrumah Ave, by Julius Nyerere Way

style.notes: Modern glass commercial high-rise ('gleaming glass facade and steel structural details'), 12 floors, award-winning; OSM gives 60 m for this part and 46 m for the adjoining angwa_city_annex (cc564026). Retail + offices.
Adjoining block of the Angwa City complex (OSM height 46 m).

landmarks.name: ZANU-PF Headquarters
landmarks.streets: Rotten Row (Overture: Abdel Gamal Nasser Rd) & Samora Machel Ave

style.notes: 15-storey postmodern HQ (completed 1990; architects Peter Martin & Tony Wales-Smith), nicknamed the 'Shake Shake' building after the gable-top Chibuku 'Shake Shake' beer carton - give it a pitched/gabled crown. Party emblem signage. Matched to the named OSM footprint ~140 m south of the Samora Machel / Rotten Row corner; adjoining b551a4bb may be its podium.

landmarks.name: Rainbow Towers Hotel & HICC
landmarks.streets: Samora Machel Ave West / Pennefather Ave, west of the Kopje area

style.notes: Ex-Sheraton (1985, Energoprojekt / arch. Dragoljub & Ljiljana Bakic) - 'golden icon': gold reflective-glass hotel tower with a curved lower section and flat top; rooms up to floor 17 (marketing claims 104 m; ~75 m assumed). Overture footprint 9db2ac07 (192x107 m) merges hotel + Harare International Conference Centre: put the tower near the east side (hotel POI -17.8315, 31.0361) and model the HICC (4,500-seat auditorium) as a ~22 m block on the rest. height/floors here are for the merged footprint (HICC level) so the pipeline does not extrude the whole 1.3 ha complex to tower height; the tower itself is in synthetic_parts.

synthetic_parts.rotation_note: align long side with the complex long axis (~25 deg clockwise from east-west, per the footprint's minimum rotated rectangle); position approximate

landmarks.name: Chaminuka Building
landmarks.streets: Fourth St & Central Ave area

style.notes: Government (CIO) slab 80x18.5 m next to Mukwati; OSM height kept.

landmarks.name: Compensation House (probable)
landmarks.streets: Cnr Central Ave (Ahmed Ben Bella Ave) & Fourth St

style.notes: Unnamed OSM tower cluster: bf3dc8ff 58.7 m + core e85a413e 70 m + wing 737201aa 45.2 m, at the Central Ave / Fourth St corner where Compensation House is listed. Identity unconfirmed - keep label off.
Tall core of the cluster (OSM 70 m).
Lower wing (OSM 45.2 m).

landmarks.name: Construction House
landmarks.streets: 110 Leopold Takawira St, near Nelson Mandela Ave / Park St

style.notes: 110 Leopold Takawira St office block (tenants to 9th floor+); 26.6 m square tower on an L-shaped retail podium (d53604e5, 'Park Street mall' shops). Floors estimated.

landmarks.name: Runhare House
landmarks.streets: Kwame Nkrumah Ave near Fourth St

style.notes: 12-floor office block (OSM 43 m); 72x29 m footprint.

landmarks.name: Electra House
landmarks.streets: Samora Machel Ave (south side) near Julius Nyerere Way

style.notes: 12-floor office block beside Karigamombe (Overture num_floors 12).

landmarks.name: Holiday Inn Harare
landmarks.streets: Cnr Samora Machel Ave & Fifth St

style.notes: 201-room hotel slab (62x23 m); green 'Holiday Inn' sign on the roofline. Floors estimated.

landmarks.name: Eastgate Centre
landmarks.streets: Cnr Robert Mugabe Rd & Second St (Sam Nujoma St), to Third St

style.notes: 1996, Mick Pearce / Arup, termite-mound-inspired passive cooling. TWO parallel 9-storey precast-concrete slabs (eastgate_block_n, eastgate_block_s: each ~142x14.5 m) either side of this ~131x24 m glass-roofed atrium (this entry = atrium; glass roof at ~22 m on steel lattice beams, suspended steel bridges + glass lifts, skywalk at level 2). Retail on 2 lower floors, offices above; parking for 450 cars.

9 storeys (~31 m to eaves). Grey unpainted precast facade with deep protruding window hoods/'teeth' shading recessed glazing; columns of steel rings on the outside carry green creepers. Red-tiled pitched roof ridge along the block carrying ~24 brick chimney funnels (48 total across both blocks), each ~1.5x1.5 m, rising ~4-6 m above the ridge.
Mirror of the south block (see eastgate_block_s).

landmarks.name: Meikles Hotel (Hyatt Regency Harare The Meikles)
landmarks.streets: Cnr Jason Moyo Ave & Third St, south side of Africa Unity Square

style.notes: Two offset multi-storey wings (North & South, 312 rooms) facing Africa Unity Square; hotel founded 1915, rebuilt 1974-76, 12-storey tower block 1980, +5 floors on North Wing 1991. This entry = north wing (OSM 43 m); south wing = meikles_south. Balconied north faces, 'MEIKLES' / 'HYATT REGENCY' roof signs.
South wing / tower block (12 storeys, 1980) offset behind the north wing.

landmarks.name: Harare Town House
landmarks.streets: Cnr Julius Nyerere Way & Jason Moyo Ave

style.notes: City Hall (1933, Mediterranean/Italian-Renaissance style, Public Works under Major Roberts). Cream rendered walls, terracotta tile roofs, arched loggia/entrance on Julius Nyerere Way, clock tower (~26 m, assumed) over the entrance. Gardens in front with a floral clock and fountain. Footprint 40x50 m U/courtyard shape.

landmarks.name: Parliament House (old Parliament of Zimbabwe)
landmarks.streets: Cnr Nelson Mandela Ave & Third St, north side of Africa Unity Square

style.notes: Began 1895 as a hotel, completed/inaugurated 1899 as the Legislative Assembly; used by Parliament until Nov 2023. 3-storey colonial block with arcaded/verandah front and hipped iron roof (renderer: flat + parapet OK). Parts: d1e9bc60, c99836f9 (later 5-floor annex).
Later 5-floor annex (Overture num_floors 5).

landmarks.name: Cathedral of St Mary and All Saints
landmarks.streets: Cnr Nelson Mandela Ave & Sam Nujoma St, NW corner of Africa Unity Square

style.notes: Anglican cathedral by Herbert Baker, begun 1913, finished 1961. Romanesque Revival in local stone (sandstone/granite), cruciform ~79x23 m plan. Square bell tower with 10 bells (~28 m, assumed; no clock face needed). Stained glass, round-arched openings.

landmarks.name: Cathedral of the Sacred Heart
landmarks.streets: Cnr Fourth St & Herbert Chitepo Ave

style.notes: Catholic cathedral (1925), Gothic Revival with two heavily adorned front towers (~24 m, assumed) with pinnacles; timber roof, stained glass. Footprint 43x22 m.

landmarks.name: National Gallery of Zimbabwe
landmarks.streets: 20 Julius Nyerere Way, cnr Park Lane

style.notes: 1957 modernist gallery (Montgomerie & Oldfield), large naturally-lit open-plan hall; white walls, flat roof with clerestory/roof-lights; sits at the SE corner of Harare Gardens.

landmarks.name: Harare Main Post Office
landmarks.streets: Julius Nyerere Way / Inez Terrace (Overture: Mayor Urimbo Terrace), between Nelson Mandela & Jason Moyo

style.notes: Main Post Office block (second footprint 56182f90 'Harare Main Post Ofiice'). Height/style not verified - mid-century stone-coloured civic building assumed.

landmarks.name: Munhumutapa Building (Office of the President and Cabinet)
landmarks.streets: Samora Machel Ave / Sam Nujoma St

style.notes: Seat of the Office of the President and Cabinet; ministries of Foreign Affairs/Information inside. Large 132x51 m irregular footprint (Overture num_floors 2 looks low). Height assumed.

landmarks.name: Harare Railway Station (NRZ)

match.name: National Railways Of Zimbabwe, Harare Train Station

landmarks.streets: Kenneth Kaunda Ave, at the south end of Sam Nujoma St

style.notes: Main passenger station + railway museum; low colonial-era block with pitched roof (renderer: flat+parapet OK). Style assumed.

places.name: Africa Unity Square
places.notes: Ex-Cecil Square (1890 pioneer flag site). ~2.4 ha rectangle (Overture land_use polygon, bounds lon 31.05117-31.05288, lat -17.83018 to -17.82846) bounded by Nelson Mandela Ave (N, Parliament + Anglican cathedral), Jason Moyo Ave (S, Meikles), Sam Nujoma St (W), Third St/Patrice Lumumba St (E). Paths laid out as a Union Jack: two corner-to-corner diagonals + a cross (one path lines up with George Silundika Ave), large central fountain (with smaller fountains), lawns, old jacarandas (purple in Oct-Nov), flower sellers and photographers along the edges.

places.name: Harare Gardens
places.notes: Main city park, ~17 ha: bordered by Herbert Chitepo Ave (N), Julius Nyerere Way / Park Lane (E and S) and Leopold Takawira St (W); the Les Brown pool, Monomotapa Hotel and parking occupy the SW corner. Lawns, flower beds, a pond on the north side, a 1930s bandstand (Sunday jazz), restaurant, playground. National Gallery at the SE corner. Approx corners: NW (-17.8235,31.0440), NE (-17.8218,31.0484), SE (-17.8252,31.0492), S (-17.8262,31.0476), SW (-17.8269,31.0448).

places.name: The Kopje
places.notes: Granite hill where Salisbury/Harare was founded (1890), SW edge of the CBD; national monument (~15 ha). Rises roughly 45-55 m above Robert Mugabe Rd (toposcope quoted at 1,539.8 m ASL; PeakVisor lists 1,496 m). Summit reached by Skipper Hoste Drive, a one-way loop from Robert Mugabe Rd/Kaguvi St. Eternal Flame of Independence (carried here from Rufaro Stadium, 18 Apr 1980) and a (vandalised) toposcope at the top. Wooded (msasa), boulders. Summit location approximate; lies just south of the current map bbox (S=-17.840).

places.name: First Street Mall
places.notes: Pedestrianised First Street (Harare's first pedestrian mall), from about Robert Mugabe Rd/Speke Ave north to Kwame Nkrumah Ave (Overture segment lat -17.8324 to -17.8279); Edgars at the Jason Moyo corner, Galaxy Mall, OK, banks. Paved, benches, vendors, crowds; open to traffic north of Kwame Nkrumah to Samora Machel.

places.name: Mbuya Nehanda Statue
places.notes: Bronze statue of the spirit medium Mbuya Nehanda (unveiled 25 May 2021, David Mutasa): 3 m figure on a 1.5 m pedestal on a corner plaza at the Samora Machel Ave / Julius Nyerere Way intersection, with pedestrian footbridges over the junction. Karigamombe Centre on the SE corner.

places.name: Simon Muzenda (Fourth Street) Bus Terminus
places.notes: Main kombi/bus terminus for Ruwa, Marondera, eastern & north-eastern suburbs; ~2.6 ha open lot (Overture polygon) east of Fourth St between Jason Moyo Ave and Robert Mugabe Rd; shelters, touts, vendors.

places.name: Charge Office Terminus
places.notes: Kombi rank for Chitungwiza and southern suburbs, next to Harare Central Police Station (Charge Office).

places.name: Copacabana Terminus
places.notes: Kombi rank for western and north-western suburbs, on Chinhoyi St / Speke Ave in the western (Kopje-side) CBD.

places.name: Market Square Terminus
places.notes: Large bus/kombi terminus (~1.3 ha) for western & southern suburbs, Harare St / Bank St area near the Kopje.

places.name: Roadport
places.notes: Long-distance / cross-border coach terminal (Fifth St & Robert Mugabe Rd).

places.name: Greenwood Park
places.notes: Leafy park in the Avenues NE of the CBD (~5.8 ha).

places.name: National Heroes' Acre
places.notes: Out of map: ~7 km W on the Bulawayo/Norton road ridge. 40 m obelisk tower topped by an Eternal Flame (lit 1982), visible from Harare - use as a distant skyline marker only. Coordinates approximate (+-1 km).
